info.description: Search, social preview, browser icon, and structured data settings for the homepage.

edit.label: Page title
edit.description: The title in the browser tab and the default title for link previews.

edit.label: Page description
edit.description: A short summary of the homepage for search metadata and link previews.

edit.label: Canonical homepage URL
edit.description: The preferred public HTTPS address for this page. Leave empty for local use.

edit.label: Open Graph title
edit.description: Optional title for link previews. Defaults to the page title.

edit.label: Open Graph description
edit.description: Optional summary for link previews. Defaults to the page description.

edit.label: Open Graph site name
edit.description: Optional site name shown in link previews. Defaults to the homepage brand name.

edit.label: Social preview image
edit.description: The default image shown when the homepage is shared.

edit.label: Open Graph image alt text
edit.description: Describe the share image. Defaults to its Media Library alt text.

edit.label: X card layout
edit.description: Choose a compact card or a large image. Defaults to the large image card.

edit.label: X account handle
edit.description: Optional site account, including the @ sign.

edit.label: X card title
edit.description: Optional override. Defaults to the Open Graph title.

edit.label: X card description
edit.description: Optional override. Defaults to the Open Graph description.

edit.label: X card image
edit.description: Optional override. Defaults to the social preview image.

edit.label: X card image alt text
edit.description: Optional description of the X card image.

edit.label: Browser tab icon
edit.description: Choose a square image for the favicon. Defaults to the brand mark.

edit.label: Google verification token
edit.description: Paste the content value from the Google Search Console verification tag.

edit.label: Bing verification token
edit.description: Paste the content value from the Bing Webmaster Tools verification tag.

edit.label: Structured data (JSON-LD)
edit.description: Enter a Schema.org JSON object or an array of objects for the homepage.
